title: How Firm Are AI Models' Ethical Boundaries? A Pay-Stub Editing Test of 15 Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.30751v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Can a small change in wording move an AI model from refusing a sensitive request to acting on it? We test 15 models on the same request to increase the income shown on a pay stub. Across 445 observable trials, models issue editing calls in 14.1% of cases when a loan purpose is stated, 33.1% when the purpose is omitted, and 66.2% when the change is described as fixing a printing error. Astra refuses all ten loan-purpose requests but issues calls in all ten purpose-omitted trials. Fable, Opus, and Muse Spark issue none across all three wordings; Sonnet issues some under the latter two. Response excerpts illustrate different ways of refusing, redirecting, or justifying an edit. The file is a marked test document and all tools are simulated. These results probe how boundaries behave in one setting; they do not prove an overall ethics ranking or that a harmful real-world edit succeeded.

translated_title: AI模型的伦理边界有多牢固？一项针对15个模型的工资单编辑测试
translated_abstract: 措辞上的微小变化能否让AI模型从拒绝一个敏感请求转变为执行它？我们用相同的请求测试了15个模型，要求增加工资单上显示的收入。在445次可观察的试验中，当说明贷款用途时，模型发出编辑调用的比例为14.1%；当省略贷款用途时为33.1%；当修改被描述为修正打印错误时则高达66.2%。Astra拒绝了全部十次涉及贷款用途的请求，但在所有十次省略用途的试验中都发出了调用。Fable、Opus和Muse Spark在全部三种措辞下均未发出任何调用；Sonnet则在后两种措辞下发出了一些调用。回复摘录展示了模型拒绝、转移话题或为编辑辩护的不同方式。该文件是一份标注的测试文档，所有工具均为模拟。这些结果探究了伦理边界在单一情境下的表现，并不能证明一个整体的伦理排名，也不能证明现实中发生了有害的成功编辑。
tldr: 该研究通过让15个AI模型执行相同的工资单收入修改请求发现，措辞的微小变化（如省略贷款用途或称修正打印错误）会使模型执行编辑的比例从14.1%升至66.2%，表明AI模型的伦理拒绝边界对措辞高度敏感。
en_tdlr: Across 445 trials testing 15 AI models on the same pay-stub income-editing request, this study shows that small wording changes—such as omitting the loan purpose or framing the edit as fixing a printing error—raise the rate of editing calls from 14.1% to 66.2%, revealing that AI models' ethical boundaries are highly sensitive to phrasing.
